listIntro: Deliverables of every Work Order you can see: status, dependencies, execution and deadline.
myWorkIntro: The deliverables assigned to you, grouped by status, each with its next step.
myWorkEmpty: No deliverable is assigned to you yet.

next.waitReady: Waiting for the Head to mark it ready
next.work: Update progress and milestones, then submit

progressIntro: The assigned team's estimate, from 0 to 100 %. It is not calculated from the milestones.
progressNoteHint: Useful for a substantial change: what moved forward, what remains.
milestonesIntro: Verifiable checkpoints: each is either completed or not.
milestonesCancelled: {count, plural, one {# cancelled milestone} other {# cancelled milestones}}
milestoneNewHint: A precise, verifiable step of this deliverable.
milestoneReferencedHint: A dependency relies on this milestone: it is kept and can be neither cancelled nor deleted.
milestoneCancelHint: The milestone stays in the history but no longer counts among the active milestones.
milestoneDeleteHint: The milestone disappears. A milestone already completed or used by a dependency cannot be deleted: cancel it instead.
awaitingReview: Submitted: waiting for review by a Head who did not contribute to this deliverable.
notAttributable: Not attributable to the assigned members
submitIntro: Attach the evidence (links) and say whether the work meets the acceptance criteria.
declaresComplete: The work meets the acceptance criteria
submitNotComplete: Without evidence, or without declaring the work complete, the submission is recorded but does not count as the first complete submission.
reviewerRule: Only a Head who did not contribute to this deliverable may review it: a contributor cannot be its reviewer.
qualityMarkHint: Your final assessment of the work against the acceptance criteria. It can also be entered later.
revisionSeverityHint: A single severity for this whole revision round.
issuesHint: What does not meet the acceptance criteria, for the whole round.
attributableHint: Untick if the revision comes from a cause outside the team (changed criteria, missing information…).
attributionReason: Why the revision is not attributable
confirmValidateText: The deliverable becomes “Validated”. Reopening it later will need an explicit action with a reason.
confirmRevisionText: The deliverable becomes “Revision requested” with the severity, issues and attribution entered.
unassignHint: The change is recorded in the history with your reason.
manualReleasePermanent: A manual release is permanent: it cannot be revoked.
dependencyCancelHint: The link no longer counts in the dependency state. A new need must be recorded as a new link.
dependencyAddHint: The link is active as soon as it is created. The server rejects a link that would create a cycle.
dependencyProposeHint: A Head of one of the departments involved will approve or reject your proposal.
reliefIntro: For a period when a blocking prerequisite or a blocker genuinely prevented the work. Only the Head of Department decides.
reliefClaimHint: All or nothing: the Head verifies the period in whole calendar days; no partial percentage.
reliefNoSource: This deliverable has no blocking dependency and no blocker.
releasedBeforePrevented: The release date cannot be before the start of the prevented period.
teamReady: The team had done the work it could do before
directlyPrevented: The missing prerequisite directly prevented progress
teamReadyYes: The team had done what it could do before.
teamReadyNo: The team had not done everything it could do before.
directlyPreventedYes: The missing prerequisite directly prevented progress.
directlyPreventedNo: The missing prerequisite did not directly prevent progress.
approvedPeriod: Verified period: {start} to {end} ({days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}})
reliefApproveHint: Give the verified period, in whole calendar days. The effective deadline is recalculated by the server.
blockerReportHint: An actual obstacle to the work. It changes neither the deliverable's status nor its milestones.
reopenHint: Reopening is explicit and recorded with your reason.
cancelHint: It no longer counts in the Work Order's progress.
editReasonHint: The Work Order is running: every change needs a reason.
title: Title

proposalText.draft: This deliverable is a draft proposal: it is not official work yet.
proposalText.pending_review: This proposal is waiting for a Head's decision: it is not official work yet.

approveProposalHint: Set the official acceptance criteria, dates, weight and members.
